notes: Verify method: downloaded and text-extracted the OOR Official RTKL Fee Schedule page (web) and PDF, the full compiled RTKL (Act 3 of 2008, legis.state.pa.us), and the Jan. 12, 2016 OOR advisory opinion (independently re-OCR'd with tesseract at 200dpi). Every quoted statute clause and every schedule line was matched verbatim (normalized quotes/whitespace). Currency: compiled text carries amendment notes only on §§ 1502–1505 (Act 29 of 2023, Nov. 16, 2023); §§ 701–706, 901–905, 1101, 1307, 1308 carry none; a web search found no 2024–2026 enacted amendment to § 1307. Adoption-date discrepancy re-observed exactly as flagged: web page says 'The OOR adopted this Official RTKL Fee Schedule on Dec. 30, 2024' while the PDF header reads 'Updated December 30, 2022'; figures identical in both. applies_to is recorded as all_public_bodies throughout; the OOR-schedule figures actually bind Commonwealth and local agencies only (judicial/legislative set their own duplication fees under § 1307(b)(1)(ii)-(iii)) — every affected row and the file's applicability_notes carry that carve-out, and the municipal applicability the gap pass cares about is correct, so it was not treated as a refute. The 2009 e-transmission and Aug. 19, 2022 advisory opinions back new_rules only (PA-9023, part of repeat's citation chain); the resolution-row language they support is independently confirmed by the schedule page and § 1308 statute text.
